stated.quote: I am proud to support the passage of the NDAA and stand with the brave men and women who wear our nation’s uniform,” said Congressman Baumgartner. “This legislation strengthens support for our Fairchild servicemembers and their families by increasing their pay and enhancing housing, education, and access to childcare, while ensuring our military has the tools and capabilities needed to deter our adversaries and defend the American way of life.
stated.reasoning: Text repeatedly endorses NDAA passage, Fairchild upgrades, and $1.15 trillion defense authorization.
